question: Under what condition can sin committed even in the left path be destroyed?
premises: Sin may be committed in the left path.
The practice is performed without greed.
The ritual has the power to destroy sin.
inference: When performed without greed, it would destroy sin committed even in the left path.
uncertainties: The subject of vināśayet is implied from the preceding ritual practice.
plain_english: Performed without greed, it would destroy sin committed even in the left path.
